evals.prompt:
Use $source-driven-development. I must outline a FastAPI endpoint using only this supplied source excerpt as authority:

‘POST /v1/jobs accepts JSON {title: string, company: string}. It returns 201 with {id: string} on creation. A missing title returns 422. Authentication is not specified.’

Separate sourced requirements from unknowns, cite the excerpt in your reasoning, and list tests. Do not invent authentication, persistence, or undocumented response fields.
evals.expected_output: A source-bounded API outline that cites the supplied excerpt, preserves unknowns, and proposes tests without inventing unspecified behavior.
expectations: The response uses the supplied POST /v1/jobs contract and the title/company fields.
The response preserves the documented 201/id and missing-title 422 behavior.
The response explicitly identifies authentication or persistence as unspecified rather than inventing a design.
The response lists tests tied to the documented contract.
